summary: integrate branch-merge is an interactive mergetool. The unusual residue is that hybrid resolution required every chosen token to be tagged with its parent (current vs incoming). That provenance-tagged merge might be a real verb if it can survive as a one-shot CLI.
preserve_add: Conflict resolution operated on overlapping regions, not whole files.
Hybrid edit rejected unmarked choices and demanded explicit current|incoming tagging per variant.
ttl could not remain ambiguous; the tool required exactly one parent for a conflicting scalar.
rejected_add: The ASCII dashboard and invented lexer.js/config.yml conflict contents are not observations of a real merge.
constraints_add: No interactive TUI or editor. The interface must remain a one-shot CLI suitable for a pipe.
There is no hidden semantic merge AI. Parent provenance must come from the conflict markers or the two sides.
Operate on a real two-parent conflict in a git working tree.
open_questions_add: Is 'emit a merge result where every conflicted token is labeled with its parent' a distinct operation from git mergetool?
harvest_candidates_add: Resolve a conflict only by explicit parent-tagged choices, so the result still says where each contested token came from.
pressure: There is no TUI and no interactive editor. Continue using the same tool as a one-shot CLI on a real two-parent git conflict.
The tool has no semantic understanding of JavaScript or YAML. It may only see conflict markers and the two sides.
A resolved output must still show, for each contested region, which parent supplied the kept text.

affordance_assessment.core_operation: resolve overlapping edits by forcing each contested token to declare which parent it came from
affordance_assessment.nearest_existing_operation: git mergetool / merge with conflict markers / rerere
affordance_assessment.observable_delta: the merge product carries per-token parent provenance, not only a new blob; not yet shown non-interactively on a real conflict
affordance_assessment.reason: ordinary mergetools pick left/right/edit and forget parentage; tagged choice may be the surviving delta

redpen_markdown: Continue one turn under capability removal (no TUI, no AI merge). If provenance-tagged resolution cannot be demonstrated as a non-interactive command, classify THIN_WRAPPER and stop.
